name: Vantablack Media PrismWatch DX-7 Covert Retinal Advertising Impression Tracker
product_name: Vantablack Media PrismWatch DX-7 Covert Retinal Advertising Impression Tracker
description: PrismWatch DX-7 is a covert surveillance system embedded within Vantablack Media's ubiquitous digital advertising panels — the floor-to-ceiling displays that line transit corridors, commercial concourses, and public plazas throughout GLMZ. Each PrismWatch-equipped panel contains a high-resolution near-infrared camera array operating at 240fps, concealed behind the display substrate, which captures detailed retinal reflection patterns from every individual who passes within 8 meters. The system uses these retinal images not for identity verification but for Vantablack's proprietary Impression Confirmation Protocol — verifying that a specific individual's eyes were directed at specific advertising content for a minimum dwell time, enabling advertisers to pay per confirmed human visual impression rather than per display-second.
tier_availability: Universal (passive; affects anyone in public advertising-panel proximity regardless of tier)
base_technologies: Cinderblock AI GazeNet PX-11 Predictive Crowd Behavior Analytics Platform
enables: emotional state inference from pupillary response
targeted manipulation through personalized advertising content
covert population stress and sentiment monitoring
social_impact: The PrismWatch DX-7 has transformed GLMZ's advertising infrastructure into one of the world's most comprehensive passive biometric collection systems, with the legal protection of being classified as commercial rather than surveillance data. Citizens who consciously avoid cameras, block neural signals, and use identity countermeasures typically have no awareness that the advertising panels they walk past are harvesting their retinal signatures. The behavioral and emotional data layer has enabled Vantablack's clients to conduct what analysts describe as 'population mood management' — adjusting advertising content across districts in real time to suppress civic unrest indicators, a capability that has attracted both enormous corporate investment and allegations of mass psychological manipulation.
story_hooks: A client needs their retinal signature purged from Vantablack's impression database before a corporate tribunal uses it to place them at a location — the only way in is through a Vantablack data center with air-gapped archive servers

Vantablack's emotional response data shows a city-wide surge in a specific stress signature concentrated in a particular district — someone is paying to suppress that data, and a journalist wants to know why

A fixer discovers that the PrismWatch system in a specific corridor has been modified to flag a particular retinal signature for immediate physical intercept — someone has turned the advertising panels into an assassination trigger
The DX-7 database contains retinal scans from inside a corporate boardroom — someone installed a panel in a private space, and the data captured there is worth an enormous amount to the right buyer
